svg.title: Post-quantum blockchain deployment timeline
svg.desc: Timeline of 17 blockchain projects by milestone year, with consensus, post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility and limits. 12 on by default on mainnet; 4 opt-in or demo on mainnet; 1 not on mainnet yet. Data as of October 23, 2026.
svg.text: 17 projects, placed by the milestone year on each card: a chain launch, a later cryptographic upgrade or a public testnet. Consensus
and cryptography are as of each entry's last review.
Renamed in 2022; old Rainbow parameters broken
Switched from PoW to PoS in Oct 2026
Falcon is optional; Brainpool remains classical
Falcon-512 live; ML-DSA in upgrade code
Multi-scheme upgrade not active on mainnet
Chain launched in 2019; consensus still classical
Main chain: PoS; zerochain: PoA · CF-20 only
Signing modes activate at protocol thresholds
Testnet uses PoA; transition to PoS is planned
Jan · SPHINCS+ lock deployed on mainnet
Chain launched in 2019; existing funds must migrate
Fallback key must be in the spending tree
Oct 5 v2 re-genesis; unrelated to Quantus
Drawn by scripts/charts.py from data/projects.json. Data and chart: CC BY 4.0.
